'''2012 Bespin Regionals Calvin Kurten DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Calvin Kurten]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
